Nowy Zmigrod Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Nowy Żmigród, Poland

Not demolished. Dating to the turn of the 16th-17th century, this cemetery served not only Nowy Żmigród but Dębowiec, Gorlice, Jasło, and Osiek as well - likely holding several thousand burials over its history. During the Holocaust, it became an execution site, with victims' bodies buried there too. The cemetery's last funeral, of Pinkas Wohlmut, took place in 1955. It entered Poland's monument register on November 23, 1990; the Society of the Friends of Nowy Żmigród has cared for it since 2008.
